ref_text.narrator: Twelve hundred years ago, they did not build a temple. They carved one, out of a living mountain.

voices.narrator_epic: male, middle-aged, very low pitch, british accent

jobs.text: This temple was not built. It was carved... from one single rock.
[surprise-oh] Two hundred thousand tonnes of stone, removed by hand. From the top, down.
One wrong strike, and there was no going back.
